<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="it">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Il tuo futuro finanziario — Antonio Silia, Consulente Finanziario</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Serif+Display:ital@0;1&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Chart.js/4.4.0/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<style>
  :root {
    --navy: #0B2B78;
    --navy2: #1a3e8f;
    --gold: #D9D9D9;
    --gold-light: #f0f0f0;
    --cream: #faf8f4;
    --cream2: #f2ede3;
    --text: #0a1a3a;
    --muted: #6b7280;
    --white: #ffffff;
    --success: #16a34a;
    --radius: 16px;
    --radius-sm: 10px;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  body {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--text);
    min-height: 100vh;
  }


  .avatar-photo {
    width: 48px; height: 48px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center top;
    border: 2px solid rgba(180,180,180,0.6);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .big-avatar-photo {
    width: 80px; height: 80px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center top;
    margin: 0 auto 16px;
    display: block;
    border: 3px solid rgba(180,180,180,0.5);
  }

  /* ── HERO ── */
  .hero {
    background: var(--navy);
    padding: 0;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .hero::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -80px; right: -80px;
    width: 400px; height: 400px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(217,217,217,0.20) 0%, transparent 70%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .hero-inner {
    max-width: 720px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 48px 24px 40px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    background: rgba(217,217,217,0.20);
    border: 1px solid rgba(180,180,180,0.5);
    color: var(--gold-light);
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .badge-dot {
    width: 6px; height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--gold);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .hero h1 {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(28px, 5vw, 42px);
    color: var(--white);
    line-height: 1.2;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .hero h1 em {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--gold-light);
  }

  .hero p {
    font-size: 16px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
    line-height: 1.7;
    max-width: 520px;
  }

  .consultant-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
    margin-top: 32px;
    padding-top: 28px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  }

  .avatar {
    width: 48px; height: 48px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold) 0%, #a0a0a0 100%);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    color: var(--navy);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border: 2px solid rgba(180,180,180,0.6);
  }

  .consultant-info p:first-child {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--white);
  }

  .consultant-info p:last-child {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  }

  /* ── NAV TABS ── */
  .nav-wrap {
    background: var(--navy2);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 100;
  }

  .nav {
    max-width: 720px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .nav-btn {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    transition: all .2s;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .nav-btn:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }

  .nav-btn.active {
    color: var(--gold-light);
    border-bottom-color: var(--gold);
  }

  /* ── MAIN CONTENT ── */
  main {
    max-width: 720px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 32px 24px 80px;
  }

  .section { display: none; }
  .section.active { display: block; }

  /* ── CARD ── */
  .card {
    background: var(--white);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
    padding: 28px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .card-title {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    color: var(--navy);
  }

  .card-sub {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* ── FORM FIELDS ── */
  .form-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 480px) { .form-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  .field-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }

  .field-group label {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--muted);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .05em;
  }

  .field-group input[type=number],
  .field-group input[type=text],
  .field-group input[type=email],
  .field-group input[type=tel],
  .field-group select,
  .field-group textarea {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 11px 14px;
    border: 1.5px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    color: var(--text);
    background: var(--cream);
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color .2s;
  }

  .field-group input:focus,
  .field-group select:focus,
  .field-group textarea:focus {
    border-color: var(--navy2);
    background: var(--white);
  }

  .field-group input[type=number]::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
  .field-group input[type=number]::-webkit-inner-spin-button { -webkit-appearance: none; }

  /* ── SLIDER ── */
  .slider-group {
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }

  .slider-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .slider-header span:first-child {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .slider-header span:last-child {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--navy);
    background: var(--cream2);
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 100px;
  }

  input[type=range] {
    width: 100%;
    accent-color: var(--navy2);
    height: 4px;
  }

  /* ── METRICS ── */
  .metrics {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 480px) { .metrics { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }

  .metric {
    background: var(--cream);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: 16px 14px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  }

  .metric-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .06em;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .metric-value {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 22px;
    color: var(--navy);
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .metric-value.good { color: var(--success); }
  .metric-value.warn { color: #d97706; }

  .metric-sub {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  /* ── CHART ── */
  .chart-container {
    position: relative;
    height: 220px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  /* ── ALERT BOX ── */
  .alert {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    background: #fffbeb;
    border: 1px solid #fcd34d;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: 14px 16px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #92400e;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .alert-icon {
    font-size: 18px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }

  /* ── CTA BUTTON ── */
  .btn-primary {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    background: var(--navy);
    color: var(--white);
    border: none;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: 14px 24px;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 500;
    cursor: pointer;
    width: 100%;
    transition: background .2s, transform .1s;
  }

  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--navy2); }
  .btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.99); }

  .btn-gold {
    background: var(--gold);
    color: var(--navy);
  }

  .btn-gold:hover { background: #c4c4c4; }

  .btn-outline {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--navy);
    color: var(--navy);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: 13px 24px;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 500;
    cursor: pointer;
    width: 100%;
    transition: all .2s;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .btn-outline:hover { background: var(--navy); color: var(--white); }

  /* ── CONTACT SECTION ── */
  .contact-hero {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 16px 0 28px;
  }

  .contact-hero .big-avatar {
    width: 80px; height: 80px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold) 0%, #a0a0a0 100%);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 28px;
    color: var(--navy);
    margin: 0 auto 16px;
    border: 3px solid rgba(180,180,180,0.5);
  }

  .contact-hero h2 {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 22px;
    color: var(--navy);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .contact-hero p {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--muted);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .contact-methods {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 480px) { .contact-methods { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  .contact-method {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    background: var(--cream);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: 14px 16px;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--text);
    transition: all .2s;
  }

  .contact-method:hover {
    border-color: var(--navy);
    background: var(--white);
  }

  .contact-method-icon {
    width: 38px; height: 38px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 18px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .contact-method-icon.wa { background: #dcfce7; }
  .contact-method-icon.tel { background: #dbeafe; }
  .contact-method-icon.mail { background: #fce7f3; }
  .contact-method-icon.cal { background: #fef9c3; }

  .contact-method p:first-child { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }
  .contact-method p:last-child { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }

  /* ── FORM CONTACT ── */
  .section-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .section-label::after {
    content: '';
    flex: 1;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--cream2);
  }

  .btn-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

  /* ── SUCCESS STATE ── */
  .success-box {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    display: none;
  }

  .success-box.show { display: block; }

  .success-check {
    width: 64px; height: 64px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #dcfce7;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 28px;
    margin: 0 auto 20px;
  }

  .success-box h3 {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 22px;
    color: var(--navy);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .success-box p {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--muted);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  /* ── INFO SECTION ── */
  .info-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 480px) { .info-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  .info-card {
    background: var(--white);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 20px;
  }

  .info-card-icon {
    font-size: 28px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .info-card h3 {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 17px;
    color: var(--navy);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .info-card p {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--muted);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .divider {
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--cream2);
    margin: 24px 0;
  }

  .testimonial {
    background: var(--navy);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 24px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .testimonial p {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 17px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .testimonial-author {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .testimonial-author-dot {
    width: 32px; height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(180,180,180,0.25);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--gold-light);
  }

  .testimonial-author span {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  }

  /* ── FOOTER ── */
  .footer {
    background: var(--navy);
    padding: 20px 24px;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
  }

  /* ── ANIMATIONS ── */
  @keyframes fadeUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  .section.active .card,
  .section.active .info-card,
  .section.active .testimonial {
    animation: fadeUp .35s ease both;
  }

  .section.active .card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .06s; }
  .section.active .card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .12s; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- HERO -->
<div class="hero">
  <div class="hero-inner">
    <div class="badge">
      <span class="badge-dot"></span>
      Personal Financial Advisor · Fineco
    </div>
    <h1>Scopri il tuo<br><em>futuro finanziario</em></h1>
    <p>Calcola la tua pensione stimata, analizza i tuoi risparmi e prenota una consulenza gratuita. Tutto in pochi minuti.</p>
    <div class="consultant-bar">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Antonio Silia - Personal Financial Advisor Fineco" class="avatar-photo">
      <div class="consultant-info">
        <p>Antonio Silia</p>
        <p>Personal Financial Advisor Fineco · Torremaggiore (FG)</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- NAV -->
<div class="nav-wrap">
  <nav class="nav">
    <button class="nav-btn active" onclick="showTab('calcola', this)">Calcolatore</button>
    <button class="nav-btn" onclick="showTab('info', this)">Chi sono</button>
    <button class="nav-btn" onclick="showTab('contatta', this)">Contattami</button>
  </nav>
</div>

<!-- MAIN -->
<main>

  <!-- ══ TAB: CALCOLA ══ -->
  <div class="section active" id="tab-calcola">

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Calcolatore pensione</div>
      <div class="card-sub">Inserisci i tuoi dati per ricevere una stima personalizzata del tuo futuro finanziario.</div>

      <div class="form-grid">
        <div class="field-group">
          <label>Età attuale</label>
          <input type="number" id="eta" value="38" min="18" max="65" oninput="calcola()">
        </div>
        <div class="field-group">
          <label>Reddito annuo lordo (€)</label>
          <input type="number" id="reddito" value="40000" oninput="calcola()">
        </div>
        <div class="field-group">
          <label>Risparmio mensile (€)</label>
          <input type="number" id="risparmio" value="300" oninput="calcola()">
        </div>
        <div class="field-group">
          <label>Patrimonio attuale (€)</label>
          <input type="number" id="patrimonio" value="15000" oninput="calcola()">
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="slider-group">
        <div class="slider-header">
          <span>Rendimento annuo atteso</span>
          <span id="rend-label">4.0%</span>
        </div>
        <input type="range" id="rend" min="1" max="10" value="4" step="0.5" oninput="calcola()">
      </div>

      <div class="slider-group">
        <div class="slider-header">
          <span>Tasso sostituzione INPS</span>
          <span id="tasso-label">65%</span>
        </div>
        <input type="range" id="tasso" min="50" max="85" value="65" step="1" oninput="calcola()">
      </div>

      <div class="slider-group">
        <div class="slider-header">
          <span>Età di pensionamento</span>
          <span id="etap-label">67 anni</span>
        </div>
        <input type="range" id="etap" min="62" max="70" value="67" step="1" oninput="calcola()">
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">La tua proiezione</div>
      <div class="card-sub" id="anni-label">Anni al pensionamento: calcolo in corso...</div>

      <div class="metrics">
        <div class="metric">
          <div class="metric-label">Pensione INPS</div>
          <div class="metric-value" id="m-inps">—</div>
          <div class="metric-sub">al mese</div>
        </div>
        <div class="metric">
          <div class="metric-label">Capitale accumulato</div>
          <div class="metric-value" id="m-cap">—</div>
          <div class="metric-sub">risparmi + interessi</div>
        </div>
        <div class="metric">
          <div class="metric-label">Rendita totale</div>
          <div class="metric-value good" id="m-tot">—</div>
          <div class="metric-sub">al mese stimata</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="chart-container">
        <canvas id="myChart"></canvas>
      </div>

      <div class="alert" id="alert-box">
        <span class="alert-icon">⚠️</span>
        <span id="alert-text"></span>
      </div>

      <button class="btn-primary btn-gold" onclick="showTab('contatta', document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn')[2])">
        📅 Prenota una consulenza gratuita
      </button>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- ══ TAB: CHI SONO ══ -->
  <div class="section" id="tab-info">

    <div class="card">
      <div class="contact-hero" style="padding-bottom: 8px;">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Antonio Silia - Personal Financial Advisor Fineco" class="big-avatar-photo">
        <h2>Antonio Silia</h2>
        <p>Personal Financial Advisor · Fineco<br>Oltre 12 anni di esperienza · Torremaggiore (FG)</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="info-grid">
      <div class="info-card">
        <div class="info-card-icon">🎯</div>
        <h3>Fineco Network</h3>
        <p>Opero nella rete Fineco da Torremaggiore (FG), uno dei gruppi bancari più solidi e digitali d'Italia.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="info-card">
        <div class="info-card-icon">📊</div>
        <h3>Pianificazione</h3>
        <p>Piano finanziario completo: pensione, investimenti, protezione del patrimonio e successione.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="info-card">
        <div class="info-card-icon">🏛️</div>
        <h3>Certificato CFP®</h3>
        <p>Iscritto all'OCF e certificato CFP® — le più alte qualifiche per i consulenti finanziari in Italia.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="info-card">
        <div class="info-card-icon">💬</div>
        <h3>Sempre disponibile</h3>
        <p>Rispondo entro 24 ore. Appuntamenti in presenza a Roma o in videocall ovunque tu sia.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="testimonial">

  Questo strumento ha finalità illustrative. I risultati non costituiscono consulenza finanziaria.
</footer>

<script>
let chartInstance = null;

function fmt(n) {
  return '€' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString('it-IT');
}

function calcola() {
  const eta = parseInt(document.getElementById('eta').value) || 38;
  const reddito = parseFloat(document.getElementById('reddito').value) || 0;
  const risp = parseFloat(document.getElementById('risparmio').value) || 0;
  const pat = parseFloat(document.getElementById('patrimonio').value) || 0;
  const rend = parseFloat(document.getElementById('rend').value) || 4;
  const tasso = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tasso').value) || 65;
  const etap = parseInt(document.getElementById('etap').value) || 67;

  document.getElementById('rend-label').textContent = rend.toFixed(1) + '%';
  document.getElementById('tasso-label').textContent = tasso + '%';
  document.getElementById('etap-label').textContent = etap + ' anni';

  const anni = Math.max(etap - eta, 0);
  document.getElementById('anni-label').textContent = anni > 0
    ? `Anni al pensionamento: ${anni} · Pensionamento previsto: ${new Date().getFullYear() + anni}`
    : 'Sei vicino al pensionamento';

  const r = rend / 100;
  const rMens = r / 12;
  const nMens = anni * 12;

  const capRisp = nMens > 0 ? risp * ((Math.pow(1 + rMens, nMens) - 1) / rMens) : 0;
  const patGrow = pat * Math.pow(1 + r, anni);
  const totCap = capRisp + patGrow;

  const pensioneInps = (reddito / 12) * (tasso / 100);
  const renditaMens = totCap / 240;
  const totMens = pensioneInps + renditaMens;

  document.getElementById('m-inps').textContent = fmt(pensioneInps) + '/mese';
  document.getElementById('m-cap').textContent = fmt(totCap);
  document.getElementById('m-tot').textContent = fmt(totMens) + '/mese';

  const redditoMens = reddito / 12;
  const isGood = totMens >= redditoMens * 0.75;
  document.getElementById('m-tot').className = 'metric-value ' + (isGood ? 'good' : 'warn');

  const alertBox = document.getElementById('alert-box');
  const alertText = document.getElementById('alert-text');
  const gap = redditoMens - totMens;

  if (!isGood && gap > 0) {
    alertText.textContent = `Attenzione: con questo piano, alla pensione potresti avere un gap di ${fmt(gap)}/mese rispetto al tuo reddito attuale. Una consulenza può aiutarti a colmare questa differenza.`;
    alertBox.style.display = 'flex';
  } else {
    alertBox.style.display = 'none';
  }

  // Chart
  const labels = [];
  const dPat = [];
  const dRisp = [];
  const step = anni > 20 ? 5 : anni > 10 ? 2 : 1;

  for (let a = 0; a <= anni; a += Math.max(step, 1)) {
    labels.push(eta + a);
    const n = a * 12;
    const capR = n > 0 ? risp * ((Math.pow(1 + rMens, n) - 1) / rMens) : 0;
    dPat.push(Math.round(pat * Math.pow(1 + r, a)));
    dRisp.push(Math.round(capR));
  }

  const ctx = document.getElementById('myChart').getContext('2d');
  if (chartInstance) chartInstance.destroy();

  chartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
    type: 'bar',
    data: {
      labels,
      datasets: [
        {
          label: 'Patrimonio iniziale rivalutato',
          data: dPat,
          backgroundColor: '#D9D9D9',
          stack: 's',
          borderRadius: 3,
        },
        {
          label: 'Risparmio accumulato',
          data: dRisp,
          backgroundColor: '#0B2B78',
          stack: 's',
          borderRadius: 3,
        }
      ]
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      plugins: {
        legend: {
          labels: {
            font: { size: 11, family: 'DM Sans' },
            boxWidth: 10,
            boxHeight: 10,
            padding: 16,
          }
        }
      },
      scales: {
        x: {
          ticks: { font: { size: 11, family: 'DM Sans' } },
          grid: { display: false }
        },
        y: {
          ticks: {
            font: { size: 11, family: 'DM Sans' },
            callback: v => '€' + Math.round(v / 1000) + 'k'
          },
          grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

function showTab(id, el) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('tab-' + id).classList.add('active');
  el.classList.add('active');
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
}

function inviaForm() {
  const nome = document.getElementById('f-nome').value.trim();
  const email = document.getElementById('f-email').value.trim();
  const errEl = document.getElementById('form-error');

  if (!nome) {
    errEl.textContent = 'Inserisci il tuo nome e cognome.';
    errEl.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }
  if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
    errEl.textContent = 'Inserisci un indirizzo email valido.';
    errEl.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }

  errEl.style.display = 'none';

  // In production: replace with fetch() to your backend or Formspree/Netlify Forms
  document.getElementById('contact-form').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('success-box').classList.add('show');
}

// Init
calcola();
</script>
</body>
</html>
